steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 41
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: You can pay in twelve installments.
This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
